title: 第377章 不曾自我堕落
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

大祭司终究是没有错过这为他准备的全羊宴。

刘盈也没有想到，这家伙居然还会再出发之前，再见自己。

也说不是上是什么感觉，刘盈就单纯的觉得此人似乎很会忽悠，而且看起来非常怕死。

若不是这样的话，谷蠡单于也不至于真的把部落中的少年人，挑选那么多，送往汉地去。

“臣回到军营之后，就将殿下说的如何安置草原牧民的事情，与单于说了一遍。”

大祭司不慌不忙的说道。

刘盈微微颔首，笑吟吟的看着大祭司：“那大祭司怎么说的，他不会也觉得寡人做这件事情，是无用功不成？”

“岂敢！”

大祭司急忙躬身说道：“臣是驽钝之人，但是大单于可是聪慧贤能之人，他并没有说殿下的计划是不可行的，倒是臣下说，如果殿下的计划在草原上真的实施下去以后，那所有匈奴王族的特权，也就从此消失了。”

“哈哈哈……”

刘盈听着大祭司说的话，直接就忍不住笑了起来。

大祭司听着刘盈的笑声，不知为何，后背上寒意竟一阵接着一阵涌起，几乎没有办法消弭那笑声中传来的似有似无的压力。

可，偏生就是这种似有似无的压力，震慑力最为可怕。

举个例子，就像是鬼……

越是没有出现的时候，所有面临这种危险的人，就越是会感到一种难以言状的恐惧。

大祭司现在面对刘盈这笑声，就是这种感觉。

他越是摸不清楚刘盈究竟是什么样的性子，心里就越发挥觉得恐惧。

谷蠡单于的心思他早就已经摸透了，这个人是真正的英雄，为了整个谷蠡部的子民们，他什么事情都可以去做。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After all, the high priest did not miss the whole sheep feast prepared for him.

Liu Ying didn't expect that this guy would actually see her again before setting off.

He couldn't tell what it was like, but Liu Ying simply felt that this person seemed to be very good at deceiving, and he seemed to be very afraid of death.

If this were not the case, Chanyu Guli would not have really selected so many young people from the tribe and sent them to the Han Dynasty.

"After I returned to the military camp, I told Shan Yu what His Highness said about how to resettle the grassland herdsmen."

The high priest said calmly.

Liu Ying nodded slightly and looked at the high priest with a smile: "Then what did the high priest say? Doesn't he also think that this person is doing this in vain?"

"How dare you!"

The high priest hurriedly bowed and said: "I am a dull man, but Shanyu is a smart and capable man. He did not say that your highness's plan is not feasible, but I said that if your highness's plan is really implemented on the grassland, all the privileges of the Huns royal family will disappear from then on."

"Hahaha..."

Liu Ying couldn't help but laugh after listening to what the high priest said.

The high priest listened to Liu Ying's laughter. For some reason, chills surged up his back one after another. There was almost no way to eliminate the vague pressure coming from the laughter.

However, it is this kind of seemingly absent pressure that has the most terrifying power.

For example, like a ghost...

The longer it doesn't appear, the more people who face this danger will feel an unspeakable fear.

This is how the high priest feels when faced with Liu Ying's laughter.

The less clear he was about Liu Ying's temperament, the more fear he felt in his heart.

He had already figured out the thoughts of Guli Shanyu. This man was a real hero. He would do anything for the people of Guli tribe.
